caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic figurine of two sheep, one larger and one smaller, lying down on a rectangular base. Both sheep are colored light gray with a textured surface to mimic wool, and they are adorned with evenly spaced circular flower-like decorations in yellow with red borders and dark centers. The ears of the sheep are pink on the inside, and their faces are detailed with darker lines suggesting eyes, nostrils, and mouths. The base on which the sheep rest has layered bands of color: yellow at the bottom, followed by green, black, white, and a reddish-brown stripe on the topmost layer. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background.
title: Chalkware Group - Lamb and Sheep
